column1: # The TSV should not have a header and should have exactly three columns:
# id to match existing metadata, field name, and field value
# If there are multiple annotations for the same id and field, then the last value is used
# Lines starting with '#' are treated as comments
# Any '#' after the field value are treated as comments.
# Vaccine strain information from Parks et al. Comparison of predicted amino acid
# sequences of measles virus strains in the Edmonston vaccine lineage
# Dates are retrieved from epi-weeks reported within strain names
# Delaware Public Health Lab isolates submitted with collection dates years
# before the DE-2026 accession year (likely date of birth); restrict to 2026
# Division and location missing from metadata but given in WHO-format isolate name
# Vaccine-derived genotype A sequences. These are Edmonston-lineage vaccine
# virus recovered from vaccine-associated illness, so their collection date
# reflects when the vaccine reaction was sampled rather than the age of the
# virus, which distorts molecular clock estimates. Mask the date so these
# sequences do not anchor the clock; the genuine 1954 Edmonston-era isolates
# are dated above and are not masked. Original dates are kept as comments.
